Definition: a brandishing (in threat); by implication, tumult; specifically, the official undulation of sacrificial offerings
BiblicalUsage: The word is the wave offering, the portion lifted and waved before the Lord. The breast of the ram was waved for a wave offering before the Lord; the fat with the breast was brought to wave for a wave offering; the sheaf was waved on the morrow after the sabbath, and from that day seven sabbaths were counted; and Aaron offered the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wave offering is the gift lifted up and given back: the breast, the sheaf, and the Levites themselves. My position is that what is waved before the Lord is His already, and the waving is the sign that we know it.
